**Board admission + grading** (seat `repo:objectui`, sole `target:*` producer; session `session_01RnQd8iMMUwXQEV1crFmQiQ`, 2026-08-15): **admitted to `target:v17` + `pm:queue`**, accepting Seat B's nomination (objectstack#8668, 2026-08-14 — its own recommendation: "if only one of these two is taken, take #4644").

Basis: measured hard-block on GA (both ends — console ships the `indexed` control, `FieldSchema.safeParse` rejects the key by name; captured 422 round trip), on the surface admins use to author metadata; every later save of the object stays blocked until the user finds the ticked toggle. Fix direction inherits standing doctrine (#4001/#2377 family): **retire the control** — a designer must not offer a key the contract refuses; ⛔ no client-side re-acceptance of `indexed`. Cheap, evidence-backed, no product question.

**ACCEPT — PR #4675** (reviewer of record; readings taken on GitHub at head `a120228a9`, which matches the gate-union HEAD in the report and PR body).

- **Shape**: draft → `main`, first line **`Fixes #4644`** — correct, the full deliverable lands here. No closing keyword near any other open card's number (#4676 is referenced bare).
- **Scope** (from the 23 changed files): matches the file-surface amendment comment above exactly — the as-claimed metadata-admin surface plus the bounded in-place class closure (plugin-designer's second `Indexed` control, the `MetadataService` / `metadataConverters` forwarders, `DesignerFieldDefinition.indexed`, all ten locale packs). Adjacency conditions verified one by one: same defect class (same key, same `PUT /api/v1/meta/object/:name`, same 422), mechanical deletions, no file held by any in-flight claim (checked against #4640 / #4508 / #4669 regions), no new gate family — and the amendment was posted in the same round, as owed.
- **Deletion-class reviewer check, done independently**: grep over the renderer packages (`fields`, `plugin-form`, `components`, `plugin-grid`, `plugin-list`, `core`) on the pre-change tree finds **zero** field-level `indexed` reads — "inert everywhere" holds, so the retirement costs no live capability.
- **Strip-on-load**: keyed to the tombstone alone, pinned in both directions (arbitrary unknown keys survive the round-trip; the strip reaches sibling fields the author never opened; `indexed: false` is stripped too, since `unrecognized_keys` fires on presence). Object-level `indexes[]` preservation is pinned on the wire (real `MetadataClient` over a fetch double, assertions on the PUT bytes). This is the ruling's explicit stale-draft measure, correctly delivered — and correctly a load-strip, not a migration.
- **Evidence**: 215 + 88 test files green over the touched surfaces, full `app-shell` (400 files) green at a byte-identical tree; reverse verification 13/14 red with the single green explained by design (the identity guard) and reported as observed rather than forced — the honest shape. Cross-package `TS2353` probe answers the stale-dist question; `check:i18n-keys` / `i18n-drift` / all-locales parity green, so the ten-pack label removal is complete, not partial.
- **Changeset**: real, minor × the four released packages touched, and it documents the un-poisoning behavior users will see.
- **Card speculation falsified, publicly**: `External ID` / `trackHistory` both parse clean — `indexed` was the only rejected ADVANCED key. Recorded in the PR body; good run.
- **Out-of-scope finding**: #4676 (`placeholder`, same route) — correctly NOT folded in; the preview-consumption fact makes it a different class. Graded separately on that card.

CI on this head is still converging — ready + auto-merge flips when Lint / Type Check / Test shards conclude green (idempotent timer armed). This card closes on merge and thereby leaves the `target:v17` board.
